name: René Repasi - Après le § 10 - Am 29
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on the 28th Regime: a new legal framework for innovative companies
part_text: 10 a. Stresses, however, that safeguards aimed at protecting workers and other vulnerable parties must not result in disproportionate regulatory burdens or limit the contractual freedom, organisational autonomy and entrepreneurial flexibility of companies opting into the 28th regime;
